stories.title: Flint High School shut on Thursday after boiler breaks down
stories.summary: Flint High School will be closed to all pupils on Thursday 19 November after the school’s boiler broke down. The school said: Our school boiler is currently down. We have no heating and the canteen are unable to prepare hot food. It said: For safety reasons, Flint High School will be closed to all students

stories.title: Policing to be reorganised into 200 local commands, each with a named commander
stories.summary: Policing across England and Wales is to be reorganised into around 200 Local Police Commands, each led by a named commander, the Home Secretary has announced. stories.title: Social care delays keep Flintshire patients in hospital
stories.summary: Ninety-two Flintshire residents were in hospital in July waiting to go home, even though they were well enough to leave, a council report shows. stories.title: Fraudsters posing as police cybercrime officers target cryptocurrency in North Wales
stories.summary: Cryptocurrency holders in Flintshire and across North Wales are being warned about fraudsters who phone pretending to be police cybercrime officers. North Wales Police said the callers falsely claim to be based in Dolgellau and are trying to steal cryptocurrency. At least two potential victims have been targeted this week, according to the force.
